title_en: Gui Guangqing — Speculation and Profiteering, Bribery Case

full_text_en:
Guangqing Gui v. — Speculation and Profiteering, Bribery Case

Defendant: Gui Guangqing, male, 51 years old, former director of Wuhan Metallurgical Research Institute, Hubei Province.

The defendant, Gui Guangqing, was prosecuted for speculation and profiteering and bribery by the Wuhan People's Procuratorate, Hubei Province, which initiated a public prosecution in the Wuhan Intermediate People's Court. The court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law and, after a public trial, found the following facts:

In July 1988, the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry allocated to Wuhan Metallurgical Research Institute a supply contract for 30 tons of nickel plates, at a price of RMB 22,100 per ton. After receiving this nickel plate contract, the defendant, Gui Guangqing, falsely claimed to the institute that, with the consent of relevant personnel of the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry, 5 tons were to be allocated to Changsha General Electric Appliance Company, and instructed staff to go to the shipping unit to handle the contract modification procedures, thereby controlling the quota for 5 tons of nickel plates. Subsequently, Gui Guangqing resold 2 tons of these nickel plates to Changsha General Electric Appliance Company at a price of RMB 82,500 per ton. In accordance with Gui Guangqing's instructions, the company gave him RMB 45,000 in cash and remitted the remaining RMB 120,000 to the shipping unit, thereby paying the full price for the 5 tons of nickel plates. Thereafter, Gui Guangqing resold another 3 tons (actually 3.114 tons) of nickel plates to Tao Moumou, an unemployed person in Wuhan, at a price of RMB 115,000 per ton, obtaining an illegal income of RMB 358,110.

In July 1988, Gui Guangqing also approved the sale of 5.004 tons of nickel plates, which were intended for the institute's production, to Zhou Moumou and others from Hanchuan County for resale. Zhou Moumou and others resold them on the spot at a markup, obtaining an illegal income of RMB 60,000, and Gui Guangqing accepted a bribe of RMB 130,000 from Zhou Moumou and others. After the case was uncovered, Gui Guangqing returned this bribe money to Zhou Moumou and others. On November 24, 1988, intimidated by the power of the law, Gui Guangqing voluntarily surrendered to the Wuhan People's Procuratorate and returned all illicit money.

The above facts are confirmed by documentary evidence and witness testimony, and the defendant confessed to them.

The Wuhan Intermediate People's Court held at trial: The defendant, Gui Guangqing, violated relevant state laws by reselling materials allocated under the state plan, with an illegal business volume of RMB 523,110 and illegal gains of RMB 403,110. His conduct constituted the crime of speculation and profiteering under Article 118 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China; Gui Guangqing, being a state functionary, used his official position to engage in criminal speculation and profiteering activities, and therefore, in accordance with Article 119 of the Criminal Law, should be given a heavier punishment; Gui Guangqing also used his official position to accept bribes, constituting the crime of bribery under Article 185(1) of the Criminal Law. In view of the extremely large amount and especially serious circumstances of Gui Guangqing's speculation and profiteering, in accordance with Article 1(1) of the "Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Regarding the Severe Punishment of Criminals Who Seriously Sabotage the Economy," he should be severely punished. Based on the amount of the bribe and the circumstances, in accordance with Article 5 of the "Supplementary Provisions on the Punishment of the Crimes of Embezzlement and Bribery" of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, punishment should be imposed under Article 2(2) thereof. Gui Guangqing committed multiple crimes, and in accordance with Article 64(1) of the Criminal Law, concurrent punishment for multiple crimes should be imposed. In accordance with Article 60 of the Criminal Law, all property illegally obtained by Gui Guangqing should be recovered. Based on the facts and circumstances of Gui Guangqing's crimes, he should be sentenced to death according to law. However, after committing the crimes, Gui Guangqing voluntarily surrendered, fully returned the illicit money, and displayed a good attitude toward admitting his guilt. In accordance with Article 63 of the Criminal Law and Article 7 of the "Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Requirement That Criminals of Embezzlement, Bribery, Speculation and Profiteering Must Voluntarily Surrender and Confess Within a Time Limit," which provides that "after the issuance of this Notice, for those economic crime cases of embezzlement, bribery, speculation and profiteering, etc., that are being handled, if the criminal has voluntarily surrendered and confessed, or has performed meritorious service by reporting other crimes, the provisions of Article 2 of this Notice shall apply," a lighter punishment may be imposed. Accordingly, on August 19, 1989, the Wuhan Intermediate People's Court rendered the following judgment:

The defendant, Gui Guangqing, is convicted of the crime of speculation and profiteering and sentenced to life imprisonment, and, in accordance with Article 53(1) of the Criminal Law, is deprived of political rights for life; he is convicted of the crime of bribery and sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of five years; the combined sentence is life imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for life.

The illicit money of RMB 336,174.78 and 2 tons of the medicinal material fritillaria seized from Gui Guangqing are to be recovered.

After the judgment of first instance was pronounced, the defendant, Gui Guangqing, appealed to the Hubei High People's Court on the grounds that he had "voluntarily surrendered and fully returned the illicit money, and requested a lenient punishment."

The Hubei High People's Court found upon trial: The facts of the crimes of the appellant, Gui Guangqing, as found in the original judgment are clear, the evidence is reliable and sufficient, the conviction is accurate, and the trial procedures are lawful. Gui Guangqing, by abusing his authority, illegally resold materials allocated under the state plan, and his conduct constituted the crime of speculation and profiteering. The amount involved in Gui Guangqing's speculation and profiteering is extremely large, the circumstances are especially serious, and as a state functionary, he has statutory circumstances for a heavier punishment. Gui Guangqing also used his official position to seek benefits for others and accepted bribes, constituting the crime of bribery. In terms of the crime, Gui Guangqing should be sentenced to death. The court of first instance, in light of Gui Guangqing's voluntary surrender and active return of illicit money, properly imposed a lighter punishment in accordance with the law. However, considering the specific circumstances of this case and the spirit of the "Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Requirement That Criminals of Embezzlement, Bribery, Speculation and Profiteering Must Voluntarily Surrender and Confess Within a Time Limit," a further lighter punishment may be imposed on Gui Guangqing in accordance with the law. In accordance with Article 52 of the Criminal Law, Gui Guangqing should also be additionally deprived of political rights. After discussion by the Judicial Committee of this court, and in accordance with Article 136(2) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, on August 29, 1989, the judgment was modified as follows:

The portion of the judgment of the Wuhan Intermediate People's Court concerning the sentence of the appellant, Gui Guangqing, is vacated; he is convicted of the crime of speculation and profiteering and sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of fifteen years, with deprivation of political rights for three years; he is convicted of the crime of bribery and sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of two years; the combined sentence is fixed-term imprisonment of fifteen years, with deprivation of political rights for three years; the illicit money and goods surrendered by Gui Guangqing are to be turned over to the state treasury in accordance with the law.
